channel.title: PkgWatch: high-risk suspicious packages on npm and PyPI
channel.description: PkgWatch statically analyses newly published npm and PyPI packages and lists the ones that look suspicious. Entries are leads for human review, not verdicts.

item.title: [HIGH 75] suspicious pypi package: taskuary 0.4.2.0
item.description:
Risk score 75/100 (high).

  • Code reads credential, browser, chat-token or wallet files and also makes network calls in the same file.
  • Code downloads a file and then executes it or marks it executable.

item.title: [HIGH 90] suspicious npm package: zego-express-engine-webrtc 3.13.120
item.description:
Risk score 90/100 (high).

  • 'preinstall' script runs a bundled JavaScript file at install time.
  • 'postinstall' script runs a bundled JavaScript file at install time.
  • Strings are assembled from long character-code chains.
  • Long high-entropy string literal (entropy above 5.0 bits per character).
  • Missing or placeholder README, repository URL.
